lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Hrmph. You're the new guy. Welcome to Bracken Isle. Try not to fall off it.
lines.subtitle: TED: Hrmph. You're the new guy. Welcome to Bracken Isle. Try not to fall off it.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: No moon tonight. Something's sat on it again, and the sea hates it. Tides go savage, storms follow.
lines.subtitle: TED: No moon tonight. Something's sat on it again, and the sea hates it. Tides go savage, storms follow.
lines.delivery: flat, matter-of-fact; he has said this before

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Across the water's the Saltgate. Dead harbour. The new money toffs in Saint Calder won't say why.
lines.subtitle: TED: Across the water's the Saltgate. Dead harbour. The new money toffs in Saint Calder won't say why.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Out here, my light's all that keeps ships off the rocks. Which is why it had better work.
lines.subtitle: TED: Out here, my light's all that keeps ships off the rocks. Which is why it had better work.
lines.delivery: gruff, a grunt on the last clause

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Beacon runs on steam, steam runs on coal. Get down to the basement engine room and feed that boiler.
lines.subtitle: TED: Beacon runs on steam, steam runs on coal. Get down to the basement engine room and feed that boiler.
lines.assist_text: Go down to the basement engine room. Take the shovel, scoop coal from the heap and load the boiler.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Well? Basement. Boiler. Coal. It's not complicated.
lines.subtitle: TED: Well? Basement. Boiler. Coal. It's not complicated.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: What are you looking at, you a new money toff?? Get off your arse and sort out the light!
lines.subtitle: TED: What are you looking at, you a new money toff?? Get off your arse and sort out the light!

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Stairs down, shovel by the coal heap, coal into the boiler. Slowly, if you must.
lines.subtitle: TED: Stairs down, shovel by the coal heap, coal into the boiler. Slowly, if you must.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: That big iron beast with the fire in it is the boiler. Shovel's by the heap.
lines.subtitle: TED: That big iron beast with the fire in it is the boiler. Shovel's by the heap.
lines.staging: Ted is above; his voice carries down the stairs.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Good. Keep feeding her. Watch the gauge needle. It climbs when she's happy.
lines.subtitle: TED: Good. Keep feeding her. Watch the gauge needle. It climbs when she's happy.
lines.assist_text: Keep shovelling until the steam gauge needle reaches the marked band.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Keep going. She's thirsty.
lines.subtitle: TED: Keep going. She's thirsty.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: More. A boiler's like a sailor. Never full.
lines.subtitle: TED: More. A boiler's like a sailor. Never full.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: There she goes! Hear the dynamo whine? Steam's up. Now get up to the lantern room.
lines.subtitle: TED: There she goes! Hear the dynamo whine? Steam's up. Now get up to the lantern room.
lines.assist_text: Climb the stairs to the lantern room at the top of the lighthouse.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Not bad for a new money toff. Steam's up. Lantern room, now, and mind the stairs.
lines.subtitle: TED: Not bad for a new money toff. Steam's up. Lantern room, now, and mind the stairs.
lines.assist_text: Climb the stairs to the lantern room at the top of the lighthouse.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: See that? Flickering like a wet match. Steam's good, so the fault's in the lamp. Take a proper look.
lines.subtitle: TED: See that? Flickering like a wet match. Steam's good, so the fault's in the lamp. Take a proper look.
lines.assist_text: Walk up to the arc lamp and inspect the burner at its centre.
lines.staging: Ted is standing at the lamp.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Cracked glass, rods burnt to stubs. That burner's finished. Hrmph. And I've no spare.
lines.subtitle: TED: Cracked glass, rods burnt to stubs. That burner's finished. Hrmph. And I've no spare.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: No burner, no light. No light, and the rocks do what rocks do.
lines.subtitle: TED: No burner, no light. No light, and the rocks do what rocks do.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Oi! Window! There's a rowboat tied up at the dock. Two men, soaked to the bone.
lines.subtitle: TED: Oi! Window! There's a rowboat tied up at the dock. Two men, soaked to the bone.
lines.assist_text: Walk to the lantern room window and look at the dock.
lines.staging: Ted is already at the window and sees the rowboat first.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Fools, out in this. They'll want shelter, and the only way up is the gate. Go down and open it.
lines.subtitle: TED: Fools, out in this. They'll want shelter, and the only way up is the gate. Go down and open it.
lines.assist_text: Leave the lighthouse, follow the path down to the iron gate and open it.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: The gate, new guy. Those two won't dry themselves on the dock.
lines.subtitle: TED: The gate, new guy. Those two won't dry themselves on the dock.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Down the path to the iron gate. Open it. The sea isn't polite.
lines.subtitle: TED: Down the path to the iron gate. Open it. The sea isn't polite.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Out the door, down the path, iron gate. Open it. Go.
lines.subtitle: TED: Out the door, down the path, iron gate. Open it. Go.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Open the gate, would you? I've been wet since breakfast and I'm starting to take it personally!
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Open the gate, would you? I've been wet since breakfast and I'm starting to take it personally!

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Oi! Gate! Open up before the sea finishes what the storm started!
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Oi! Gate! Open up before the sea finishes what the storm started!

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Please! My hands have gone numb and I think my boots are full of fish!
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: Please! My hands have gone numb and I think my boots are full of fish!

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Bless you. You'll be Ted's new guy, then. Jeff. The shivering one's Daniel.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Bless you. You'll be Ted's new guy, then. Jeff. The shivering one's Daniel.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Thank you, thank you! This was my first trip out. I might just stay on this flipping lighthouse!
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: Thank you, thank you! This was my first trip out. I might just stay on this flipping lighthouse!

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Don't ask what we were doing out there. Ask me when I'm dry.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Don't ask what we were doing out there. Ask me when I'm dry.
lines.note: Open hook: why Jeff and Daniel were on the water in eclipse season. Not answered.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Jeff. Thought you'd have drowned by now.
lines.subtitle: TED: Jeff. Thought you'd have drowned by now.
lines.note: Ted and Jeff's relationship is TBD in the lore; this keeps it neutral.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Lovely to see you too, Ted. Still charming the guests, I see.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Lovely to see you too, Ted. Still charming the guests, I see.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Warm's down in the engine room. Take the boy and dry out. Don't touch my boiler.
lines.subtitle: TED: Warm's down in the engine room. Take the boy and dry out. Don't touch my boiler.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Oh, it's warm. It's lovely. Nobody mind me. I'm staying right here.
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: Oh, it's warm. It's lovely. Nobody mind me. I'm staying right here.
lines.staging: Daniel stays in the basement for the rest of the slice.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Now listen. The burner's gone and I've no spare. There's one at the old outpost across the Gullwater.
lines.subtitle: TED: Now listen. The burner's gone and I've no spare. There's one at the old outpost across the Gullwater.
lines.staging: Ted talks with the player in the hall.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Small thing, under a foot tall. Brass and iron, thick glass, carbon rods. Can't miss it.
lines.subtitle: TED: Small thing, under a foot tall. Brass and iron, thick glass, carbon rods. Can't miss it.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Launch is at the dock. Jeff knows that water better than I do. Go with him and do as he says.
lines.subtitle: TED: Launch is at the dock. Jeff knows that water better than I do. Go with him and do as he says.
lines.assist_text: Go to the dock and board the steam launch with Jeff.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Cross the Gullwater? In this? Hrmph. Fine. That sky's turning nasty, and somebody has to do it.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Cross the Gullwater? In this? Hrmph. Fine. That sky's turning nasty, and somebody has to do it.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Back out there? I've only just got dry! ...Aye, all right. Better the light's mended than we're sorry.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Back out there? I've only just got dry! ...Aye, all right. Better the light's mended than we're sorry.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Dock. Launch. Jeff's waiting, and he's not known for patience.
lines.subtitle: TED: Dock. Launch. Jeff's waiting, and he's not known for patience.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Down the path, through the gate you opened, to the jetty. Steam launch.
lines.subtitle: TED: Down the path, through the gate you opened, to the jetty. Steam launch.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Jetty. Launch. Burner. In that order.
lines.subtitle: TED: Jetty. Launch. Burner. In that order.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: In you get. Mind the rail. It bites.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: In you get. Mind the rail. It bites.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Wait! Look out on the water! Lights! That's a passenger ship!
lines.subtitle: TED: Wait! Look out on the water! Lights! That's a passenger ship!
lines.staging: Shouted from the lighthouse; the ship's lights appear as he speaks.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: What the hell is a passenger ship doing coming here, now?? It's not in the log!
lines.subtitle: TED: What the hell is a passenger ship doing coming here, now?? It's not in the log!

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: A passenger ship? NOW? But the lighthouse beacon is broken!
lines.subtitle: JEFF: A passenger ship? NOW? But the lighthouse beacon is broken!
lines.delivery: frantic; canon sample line shared with Ted

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: She's making for the Saltgate. Without my light she'll find the reef instead. Get me that burner!
lines.subtitle: TED: She's making for the Saltgate. Without my light she'll find the reef instead. Get me that burner!

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Right. That settles it. Cast off, and hold on to something.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Right. That settles it. Cast off, and hold on to something.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: One wheel, one speed. She goes where you point her, and not a yard faster. Mind the rocks.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: One wheel, one speed. She goes where you point her, and not a yard faster. Mind the rocks.
lines.assist_text: Steer left and right to keep clear of rocks. The boat's speed is fixed. Head for the outpost.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Easy does it. Get the feel of her.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Easy does it. Get the feel of her.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Close! Another hand's width and we'd be lunch for the reef!
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Close! Another hand's width and we'd be lunch for the reef!

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Steady! That rock didn't move. You did.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Steady! That rock didn't move. You did.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Ugh! Gently! She's a boat, not a battering ram!
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Ugh! Gently! She's a boat, not a battering ram!

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: That's the rocks saying hello. Back on course!
lines.subtitle: JEFF: That's the rocks saying hello. Back on course!

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: That's the outpost. Find the burner. Brass, glass, under a foot tall. I'll hold the boat.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: That's the outpost. Find the burner. Brass, glass, under a foot tall. I'll hold the boat.
lines.assist_text: Search the outpost for the replacement burner. It is small, brass and glass.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: It's small, it's brass, and it won't find itself.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: It's small, it's brass, and it won't find itself.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: Look about, new guy. Brass and glass, under a foot tall.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: Look about, new guy. Brass and glass, under a foot tall.

lines.speaker: JEFF
lines.text: That's the one! Hold it tight. Aboard, and we go back.
lines.subtitle: JEFF: That's the one! Hold it tight. Aboard, and we go back.
lines.note: Hands over to the Agent Crew's JEFF_RET_* calls at RETURN_DEPARTED.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Hrmph. Leave that. Old paper, older than my knees.
lines.subtitle: TED: Hrmph. Leave that. Old paper, older than my knees.
lines.note: Ted's link to the Flighted is undecided. This hints without answering.

lines.speaker: TED
lines.text: Wind in the walls. Always is. Ignore it.
lines.subtitle: TED: Wind in the walls. Always is. Ignore it.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Did the wall just... no. No, it's the boiler. It's definitely the boiler.
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: Did the wall just... no. No, it's the boiler. It's definitely the boiler.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Best seat in the house, this. Warm, dry, and only mildly creaky.
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: Best seat in the house, this. Warm, dry, and only mildly creaky.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Don't mind me. I'll just sit here and keep the boiler company.
lines.subtitle: DANIEL: Don't mind me. I'll just sit here and keep the boiler company.

journal.text: Ted wants the boiler fed. Coal into the firebox, in the basement engine room. Watch the gauge.
Steam is up and the beacon flickers. Ted wants me in the lantern room.
The burner is cracked and burnt out. No burner, no light. Ted has no spare.
Two sailors have moored at the dock. Ted says open the island gate.
Jeff and Daniel are in. Daniel is warming up by the boiler.
A spare burner is at the old outpost across the Gullwater. Take the launch with Jeff.
A ship's lights on the water. We need that burner. Keep clear of the rocks.
